name: our-game-shelf
description: Two-player games (Connect Four, Battleships, Hues, IPOs) for two phones, kept in sync by Firebase.

scripts.check: for f in public/js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/firebase-config.mjs --stub && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-gameshelf "node tests/e2e/two-players.mjs"
